mechanism: Dexamethasone may reduce chloroquine efficacy through CYP3A4 induction and immunosuppression, while chloroquine can inhibit metabolism and increase corticosteroid levels; both drugs increase myopathy and retinopathy risk.
action: Monitor for reduced antimalarial/autoimmune efficacy and increased corticosteroid adverse effects; consider alternative antimalarial if prolonged dexamethasone use; baseline and periodic ophthalmologic screening recommended.
